subject: geography
title: Largest in India & Asia
description: Geographical superlatives - largest, highest, longest in India and Asia

content.overview: India holds many geographical superlatives in Asia and the world. These are important for competitive exams.
keyPoints: Largest desert in India: Thar Desert (Rajasthan)
Largest river in India: Ganga (2,525 km)
Largest lake in India: Wular Lake (J&K) / Vembanad Lake (Kerala) - brackish water
Largest delta in world: Sundarbans (India & Bangladesh)
Highest peak in India: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) / K2 (8,611 m) - disputed
Highest peak entirely in India: Nanda Devi (7,816 m)
Longest coastline: India has 7,516 km coastline
Largest temple: Angkor Wat (Cambodia) / Srirangam Temple (India)
Longest national highway: NH-44 (Srinagar to Kanyakumari)

mnemonics.trick: R-G-L-W-D = Rajasthan (state), Ganga (river), Loktak (freshwater lake), Wular (lake), Sundarbans (delta)
mnemonics.explanation: Largest: Rajasthan (state), Ganga (river), Loktak (freshwater lake), Wular (lake), Sundarbans (delta)

quiz.question: Which is the largest state of India by area?
quiz.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest state by area (342,239 sq km)

quiz.question: Which place receives highest rainfall in the world?
quiz.explanation: Mawsynram (Meghalaya) receives the highest rainfall in the world

quiz.question: Which is the largest delta in the world?
quiz.explanation: Sundarbans is the largest delta in the world
